articles.summary: FOSTER CITY, CA (November 15, 2022) — Apollomics Inc., an innovative biopharmaceutical company committed to the discovery and development of mono- and combination-oncology therapies, today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted Orphan Drug Designation to vebreltinib (APL-101) for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with…
articles.title: Apollomics Inc. Receives FDA Orphan Drug Designation for Vebreltinib (APL-101) for Treatment of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer with MET Genomic Tumor Aberrations
